notes.title: Immersion
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35725307/82291315891fd88caeff705341269840cbde8622.png[/img]
We received a lot of positive reviews about the Rorschach test in OMNIMUS, which very accurately reveals the identity of the reader, acting out the main character, and at the same time breaks the fourth wall a little. Also, some readers were saddened by the fact that they were not allowed to play chess with the girls.

Therefore, we decided to release [b] a free add-on [/b], which includes a set of three mini-games.
[olist]
[*] Rorschach test
[*] Chess (you can choose an opponent - Kira or Becky)
[*] Problems of logic
[/olist]
Unfortunately, artificial intelligence in chess is not very smart, it does not know that castling can be done, and it does not always correctly determine the end of a game.

notes.title: Welcome to the future!
notes.content:
Here is the long-awaited release of our visual novel.
Several hours of a fascinating story about a daring experiment are waiting for you.

The game has an Extra section in which illustrations and icons will appear as you progress. Steam achievements in accordance with the rules of the site will only make sense with a lot of activity in the community, so we will be grateful for any feedback. As soon as Omnimus overcomes the restrictions, we will add achievements and possibly trading cards.
